name: understand-chat
tagline_zh: 对着陌生代码库发问，它用知识图谱把调用关系画成地图。别人还在翻文件，你已看到全局。
tagline_en: Ask questions about any codebase; it maps calls into a knowledge graph. While others dig files, you see the whole.
desc_en: Use when you need to ask questions about a codebase or understand code using a knowledge graph
why_zh: 同类工具只给答案，它给可交互的依赖图谱，让你自己发现隐藏关联，理解深度远超普通问答。
why_en: Unlike Q&A tools that just answer, it builds an interactive dependency graph, revealing hidden links for deeper understanding.
